findings: CoLT coalesces consecutive VA-to-PA translations, examines a fetched PTE cacheline, and places coalescing mostly on the fill path.

Section4.1.5 implements shared attributes and whole-entry invalidation, but explicitly identifies separate per-translation attributes and selective uncoalescing/invalidation as future improvements. Do not present those ideas alone as newly conceived.

Section4.2.4 explicitly accounts for comparator/adder lookup complexity by reducing fully-associative entry count and discusses avoiding an extra scan/port. R must compare a full latency/capacity/circuit-cost point, not claim old work ignored lookup cost.
effect: R sparse nonlocal COPY relation remains a conditional complete-mechanism cost question; no independent half-invalidation claim.
